brief.summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana reach Prayaga, meet Sage Bharadwaja, receive hospitality, and are advised to dwell at Mount Chitrakuta.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana stand respectfully before Sage Bharadwaja as he offers oblations into the sacred fire in his forest hermitage.
At sunset the brothers arrive at the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna, with smoke from the hermitage rising above the forest.
Bharadwaja seated among deer and birds in his hermitage welcomes the exiled princes and Sita with offerings of fruits and water.
